profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google | Cornell alum
profile.summary: Hi I’m Adriana! I graduated from Cornell University in 2024 as first-gen student double-majoring in Computer Science and Spanish with a minor in Latin American Studies. I have an interest in developing technology for social good and I'm also an advocate for women and minorities in computing :)

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Gmail API, MCP, and Frontend/Backend Infrastructure 💌🛠️

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Gmail Frontend Infrastructure 💌🛠️

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Spring '23 to Fall ‘23 - Collaborating with Clean The World Foundation to build an app to gather and interpret data collected from fog nets in Lima, Peru
Fall '22 - Served as Product Manager for the Earth Law Center project overseeing product design and the development timeline while handling logistics of team meetings and meetings with our non-profit partners

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked with a team of developers to build and develop a volunteer management system for Love Living at Home, a nonprofit based in Tompkins County, New York
- Implemented email-sending functionality using Flask and SQLAlchemy to send volunteers notice about new volunteering requests that need to be fulfilled

positions.title: Vice President of Brand
positions.description: - Lead and manage a group of 5 directors to carry out design, photography, publicity, and technical tasks for the organization

positions.title: Co-Treasurer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with Presidents and Vice-Presidents to develop Fall '21 and Spring '22 budgets to allocate funds towards recruitment and events for community-building and professional development
- Worked with Cornell's CIS accounting department and companies to process corporate sponsorships

positions.title: Outreach Co-Chair
positions.description: Engaging with and fostering strong connections among the Computing & Information Science community

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: Ithaca, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- TA for CS 4320 - Introduction to Database Systems
- Provide academic support to students by hosting weekly office hours and answering student questions on an online class discussion board

company.name: Cornell Ann S. Bowers College of Computing and Information Science

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a new automated approach to Google Chat Takeout by utilizing protocol buffer annotations to hasten the development process for new Chat features
- Wrote generic classes in Java to process raw Chat resources from backend servers and convert them to a human-readable, JSON format by recursively parsing protocol buffer annotations with reflection techniques
- Google Chat Backend - Data Stewardship Team
positions.insights: Skills: Guice · Protocol Buffers · Java · JUnit · Back-End Development

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an internal web application feature utilizing several Google infrastructures to help thousands of Android engineers visualize and understand raw Android data
- Wrote queries in SQL to understand the Android database and to implement a pipeline to process the raw data and see how they are related to create a dependency graph
- Completed entire development process, including writing design docs, implementation, going through design reviews, and launching internally
- Backend development using Java, SQL, Guice, Promises, Protocol Buffers, and JUnit tests
- Android Telemetry Team
positions.insights: Skills: Guice · Technical Writing · Java · SQL · JUnit

positions.title: Summer Immersion Program Participant
positions.description:
- Learned and applied skills in Python, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and Arduino C to complete daily coding projects
- Strengthened public speaking skills via weekly professional development workshops
- Created 15 minute final presentation detailing implementation of GreenPath project; Presented to a crowd of 50 people including Johnson & Johnson employees

organizations.name: Rewriting the Code
organizations.position: Latinas de RTC Member · Nov 2021 - Present
organizations.description: The Latinas de RTC group is for Latina women in technology and engineering majors to share experiences and advice, have a familiar community within the tech industry, and gain support from having a group of women with shared interests.

organizations.name: ColorStack
organizations.description: ColorStack's mission is to increase the number of Black and Latinx Computer Science graduates that go on to start rewarding technical careers.
